parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about the ecocapsule, a new sustainable invention. For questions 1 to 5 decide if the statements are true or false. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: The Ecocapsule was designed to be a self-sustaining permanent home.
The Ecocapsule pretends to be as small as possible, but letting the owners have enough space for their things.
The Ecocapsule offers enough energy for human necessities, although may not be enough when the weather is not suitable.
The round shape of the Ecocapsule makes collecting water easier.
The Ecocapsule can be transported cheaply all around the world.
